title: The 3 Secrets of Old Faithful Geysers

scenes.text: Old Faithful erupts 3 times a day—here’s why!
scenes.query: Old Faithful Geyser geyser eruption close up

scenes.label: EERIE PRECIPITATION
scenes.text: The geyser releases steam and water in a dramatic white plume, reaching up to 70 meters.
scenes.query: Old Faithful Geyser geyser white plume

scenes.label: TIMED TRIGGER
scenes.text: Its eruptions follow a precise 91‑minute cycle, a natural clock powered by underground pressure.
scenes.query: Old Faithful Geyser geyser eruption cycle

scenes.label: HOT WATER SOURCE
scenes.text: The water originates 3.6 km below the surface, heated by volcanic activity in the Yellowstone caldera.
scenes.query: Old Faithful Geyser hot spring underground source

description: Old Faithful is not just a geyser—it’s a marvel of natural engineering. Learn the science behind its stunning eruptions and why it’s a must‑see in Yellowstone. Follow for more amazing landscapes!
